blocks.text: The wish

PortableDoc must become amazing at showing diffs and other coding-architecture PR visuals — filetrees above all. Build the new block types USING Scaffy itself (bp scaffy run add-block-type), time and token-measure the scaffold step, and ship a premium Paper that uses the new blocks to demonstrate themselves — a real diff from this wave's own commits, a real annotated filetree of this wave's own files, and a benchmark table of what Scaffy saved. The user explicitly invites convenience leaps (chain commands, variables, scripting with Scaffy) but rules them ratify-or-reject with THIS build as the fixture: incredible quality in the shortest time, and we never ship what doesn't earn its place.

blocks.text: Direction — what the finished wave looks like

Exactly two blocks ship: diff and filetree. Each is BORN via bp scaffy run add-block-type --var BlockName=… — the 3-surface skeleton, fail-closed JS test parity, and pd-parity harness entry arrive free and byte-consistent, with the engine's own duration_ms recorded and tokens = 0. Then agents GROW the real renderers: unified-diff rendering with honest +/-/hunk semantics (View HTML with add/del line styling via paper-surface.css, TUI with color + prefix that degrades to prefix-only, JS react emitter), and an annotated filetree with the ● created / ○ injected / ✕ deleted / = skipped glyph vocabulary every scaffy paper hand-fakes in code blocks today, plus per-node annotations and a legend. Grow time per surface is metered with the W6 meter law (claude --output-format json, total_cost_usd + usage) so the benchmark table is real: scaffold ms, grow time per surface, total, and what Scaffy saved. The W1 '56–80k tokens' folklore is BANNED as data (D69a) — if W6's arm-B add-block-type cell has landed, its fresh number is the baseline; otherwise the paper says 'no measured pre-scaffy baseline' honestly.

Content-shape leanings (Decide finalizes): diff carries one verbatim unified-diff text field plus optional file/lang metadata — parsing happens at render time, authoring stays paste-a-diff simple. filetree leans author-friendly indented text lines with a per-line annotation suffix, degrading honestly to plain text on any ceiling-limited surface; a structured-nodes shape is the alternative if survey shows the text shape too fragile. Extras (pr-card, commit, annotated-code with line highlights) default to CUT — they ship only if scouts find real hand-faked instances proving need.

The convenience/innovation axis is judged with D55 discipline — no primitive without a fixture that dies without it. Building two blocks back-to-back IS the deferred composition fixture: if the honest step list (run add-block-type → grow → classify-block-type → parity seed) turns out to be a 3-line shell recipe, we RULE it a documented recipe and say so in the paper; a chain primitive or --plan batch-vars ships only if the build demonstrably bleeds without it. Multi-line payload vars are presumed unnecessary (block CONTENT lives in the paper document, not in --var values; D33 bans newline vars for K-invariance) — a scout verifies before Decide rules.

Deliverables: (a) diff + filetree LIVE on all surfaces, gates green, view-edit parity, pd-parity harness entries; (b) scaffold-vs-grow timing captured during the actual build; (c) THE self-demonstrating premium Paper (style=article, tags pre-registered) with a real diff of this wave's commits, a real filetree of this wave's tree, the benchmark table, and the convenience verdict; (d) showcase/corpus reconcile only if a command is amended (one reconcile slice, D61, and only after W5 round-3 merges); (e) charter decisions for anything ratified.

body.html:
Scaffy · Wave 7 · Dogfood — the tool builds the blocks that tell its story

Scaffy W7 — diff + filetree blocks, scaffolded by Scaffy, timed, self-demonstrating

IN FLIGHT: BUILDING — decisions D74-D87 locked (charter committed + pushed, 945c54650). 5 slices dispatched in 3 rounds: round 1 birth (scaffy-w7-birth) + corpus prose truth (scaffy-w7-corpus-prose); round 2 after birth MERGES: grow-go (scaffy-w7-grow-go) + grow-web (scaffy-w7-grow-web); round 3 after both grows MERGE: the self-demonstrating paper (scaffy-w7-dogfood-paper). Backlog filed: scaffy-backlog-classify-append-redesign, scaffy-backlog-blocks-editable-studio.

The wish

PortableDoc must become amazing at showing diffs and other coding-architecture PR visuals — filetrees above all. Build the new block types USING Scaffy itself (bp scaffy run add-block-type), time and token-measure the scaffold step, and ship a premium Paper that uses the new blocks to demonstrate themselves — a real diff from this wave's own commits, a real annotated filetree of this wave's own files, and a benchmark table of what Scaffy saved. The user explicitly invites convenience leaps (chain commands, variables, scripting with Scaffy) but rules them ratify-or-reject with THIS build as the fixture: incredible quality in the shortest time, and we never ship what doesn't earn its place.

Where the epic stands (reconciled 2026-07-17)

• W1–W4 SEALED: 12-command corpus in scaffy/commands/, grammar v2 + validator + apply engine (run/remove/receipts/REANCHOR/dry-run), commands served from guerrilla (pull / ls --remote), reversibility proof 6/6.
• W5 7 of 8 done: ONEOF, add-error-shape, add-canonical-marker, ensure-* family, add-backfill-task, add-block-type v2 (pd-parity leg, #3904), ONEOF commands. Round-3 reconcile-seed-showcase is IN PROGRESS and owns internal/scaffy/corpus_test.go + scaffy/README.md until it merges — W7 keeps its hands off both.
• W6 (benchmark duels, D63–D73) runs CONCURRENTLY: it owns tooling/scaffy-duels/, tooling/scaffy-mine/, and benchmark papers — never pdrender/compose/react. W7's surfaces are disjoint by design.
• Prior art alert: pdrender already registers a chat-tool-diff renderer (pdrender.go:382). A new diff block must reconcile with it — generalize, delegate, or differentiate with stated reasons; never two independent diff renderers.

Direction — what the finished wave looks like

Exactly two blocks ship: diff and filetree. Each is BORN via bp scaffy run add-block-type --var BlockName=… — the 3-surface skeleton, fail-closed JS test parity, and pd-parity harness entry arrive free and byte-consistent, with the engine's own duration_ms recorded and tokens = 0. Then agents GROW the real renderers: unified-diff rendering with honest +/-/hunk semantics (View HTML with add/del line styling via paper-surface.css, TUI with color + prefix that degrades to prefix-only, JS react emitter), and an annotated filetree with the ● created / ○ injected / ✕ deleted / = skipped glyph vocabulary every scaffy paper hand-fakes in code blocks today, plus per-node annotations and a legend. Grow time per surface is metered with the W6 meter law (claude --output-format json, total_cost_usd + usage) so the benchmark table is real: scaffold ms, grow time per surface, total, and what Scaffy saved. The W1 '56–80k tokens' folklore is BANNED as data (D69a) — if W6's arm-B add-block-type cell has landed, its fresh number is the baseline; otherwise the paper says 'no measured pre-scaffy baseline' honestly.

Content-shape leanings (Decide finalizes): diff carries one verbatim unified-diff text field plus optional file/lang metadata — parsing happens at render time, authoring stays paste-a-diff simple. filetree leans author-friendly indented text lines with a per-line annotation suffix, degrading honestly to plain text on any ceiling-limited surface; a structured-nodes shape is the alternative if survey shows the text shape too fragile. Extras (pr-card, commit, annotated-code with line highlights) default to CUT — they ship only if scouts find real hand-faked instances proving need.

The convenience/innovation axis is judged with D55 discipline — no primitive without a fixture that dies without it. Building two blocks back-to-back IS the deferred composition fixture: if the honest step list (run add-block-type → grow → classify-block-type → parity seed) turns out to be a 3-line shell recipe, we RULE it a documented recipe and say so in the paper; a chain primitive or --plan batch-vars ships only if the build demonstrably bleeds without it. Multi-line payload vars are presumed unnecessary (block CONTENT lives in the paper document, not in --var values; D33 bans newline vars for K-invariance) — a scout verifies before Decide rules.

Deliverables: (a) diff + filetree LIVE on all surfaces, gates green, view-edit parity, pd-parity harness entries; (b) scaffold-vs-grow timing captured during the actual build; (c) THE self-demonstrating premium Paper (style=article, tags pre-registered) with a real diff of this wave's commits, a real filetree of this wave's tree, the benchmark table, and the convenience verdict; (d) showcase/corpus reconcile only if a command is amended (one reconcile slice, D61, and only after W5 round-3 merges); (e) charter decisions for anything ratified.

Survey plan — 16 scouts, one question each

• diff-prior-art — map chat-tool-diff across all surfaces (pdrender.go:382, compose.ex, JS core.ts): content shape, rendering, reuse potential. WHY: decides generalize vs delegate vs differentiate for the diff block.
• add-block-type-reality — read add-block-type.scaffy in full at origin/main: vars/ONEOF, skeleton files, MARKs, ASSERT CMDs, pd-parity leg; dry-run it with BlockName=diff. WHY: the wave's engine step must work as promised before anything else.
• pd-parity-harness — gen_pd_parity.ex @inputs shape, EXPECTED_COUNT + count-assert current values, how the v2 leg bumps them. WHY: deliverable (a) requires harness entries per new block.
• surface-map-elixir — compose.ex code-block clause + catch-all position, paper-surface.css structure, root.html.heex editor affordances for recent blocks. WHY: scopes the Elixir/CSS grow work and the view-edit parity bar.
• surface-map-js — core.ts emitter pattern, CASES fixture + toHaveLength current count, code emitter styling. WHY: scopes the JS grow work and the fail-closed test bump.
• surface-map-tui — pdrender code renderer (chroma? diff lang?), color/degrade idioms in terminal/status-legend/pipeline renderers. WHY: honest +/- TUI semantics with a stated degrade path.
• filetree-idiom — census of hand-faked filetrees + glyph vocabulary in live papers and scaffy/showcase payloads. WHY: the filetree content shape is designed from real usage, not invented.
• block-classification — tiers.ex word lists + classify-block-type.scaffy: where diff/filetree classify; does walk.ex need touching? WHY: D11 conditional steps + the chain-fixture candidate.
• chain-need-census — the COMPLETE honest step list of adding a block end-to-end today; which steps are scaffy commands vs manual; does run→classify→parity form a real chain? WHY: the ratify-or-reject convenience verdict rests on this census.
• multiline-vars — does anything in this build actually need multi-line --var payloads or new variable machinery? WHY: the wish asks; presumption is NO — verify.
• benchmark-baseline — W6 duel results state (any arm-B add-block-type numbers landed?), W6 file ownership map for deconfliction. WHY: the benchmark table's baseline must be measured or honestly absent (D69a).
• w5-reconcile-state — where scaffy-w5-reconcile-seed-showcase stands (corpus count on main, seeding, showcase); what W7 may NOT touch until it merges. WHY: D61 window + sequencing law.
• paper-mechanics — live tag registry diff for candidate W7 tags; ingest path health; block vocabulary for the premium paper; where the checked-in payload lives. WHY: publish wall is exact-string; 422s are avoidable.
• extras-evidence — pr-card / commit / annotated-code: any hand-faked instances anywhere in live papers or real consumer need (github plugin, chat surfaces)? WHY: default CUT stands unless evidence overturns.
• editor-edit-path — what a new block type needs to be editable in-canvas (everything-editable coverage: auto or per-type registry?), and what the editor does with unknown types today. WHY: view-edit parity is a deliverable, not a hope.
• timing-capture — verify bp scaffy run -o json emits duration_ms (D39 envelope); confirm the D66 meter recipe is reusable for grow-time without touching W6's files. WHY: deliverable (b) needs a working stopwatch before the build starts.

Operational law binding this wave

• No W7 slice touches internal/scaffy/corpus_test.go or scaffy/README.md until W5 round-3 merges; command amendments (if any) follow D61 — one reconcile slice.
• No W7 slice touches tooling/scaffy-duels/, tooling/scaffy-mine/, or W6 benchmark papers — W6 owns them concurrently.
• Elixir-touching slices wait for the Elixir Test lane; rounds/after declared honestly for the dispatcher (native since d38434b53).
• New paper tags pre-registered before publish (exact-string wall); pd-parity @inputs gains an entry per new block — the add-block-type v2 leg covers this, a verifier confirms.
• This paper is the wave's living story: Digest appends the survey digest + verify plan; Decide appends decisions + the wave plan; Review closes it as the debrief. Slice tasks carry wave_paper = bp-scaffy-wave7-2026-07-17.

Survey digest — 13 reports, folded 2026-07-17

The premise holds and the ground is firmer than assumed. add-block-type v2 is real, narrow, and was RUN live by a scout (dry-run duration_ms=26-38; a real apply in a disposable worktree created diff.go/diff_test.go and applied all 9 injections byte-for-byte, receipt written). It has ZERO ONEOF usage and exactly 5 vars — both censuses read 46 today, so a diff run is 46-to-47 and filetree 47-to-48. The scaffold's output is a flat-text starter on every surface: ALL diff/filetree semantics (unified-diff parsing, +/- styling, tree annotation) are grow-time work, exactly what the benchmark wants to meter. The engine stopwatch is genuine (apply.go:245/:317) and tokens=0 is structural — no LLM in the path. Multi-line --var machinery is PROVEN unnecessary and impossible (D33a engine-rejects newlines, subst.go:64-66; block content lives in the paper, never in vars).

• RECONCILIATION GROUND TRUTH: exactly one diff renderer per surface exists today (chat-tool-diff: chat_blocks.go:37-152 consumes precomputed {op,text} lines; components.ex:791-823 re-derives via TextDiff.diff_lines/2; chat.ts:34-190 is a THIRD independent LCS port). Its contract is raw-tool-input/LCS-derived — the mirror image of the new diff block's verbatim-unified-diff-text contract. Straight delegation is NOT viable (authors would fake old_string/new_string). Convergent scout recommendation: differentiate at the build layer, SHARE the {op,text}-to-styled-row rendering vocabulary (+/- prefixes as semantic carrier, 20-line budget fold, truncate-never-rewrap, color never load-bearing at NoColor).
• CHAIN REALITY: the imagined 3-command chain is TWO commands — add-pd-parity-entry was folded into add-block-type v2 (Surface 4, commit 646b4a4e3). classify-block-type is MANDATORY, not conditional: tiers_test.exs:115-121 regex-scans compose.ex and reds on any renderable-but-unclassified type; add-block-type's own prose undersells this ('conditional') — a one-line prose fix is warranted. Chain-need-census verdict: REJECT a chain primitive (D55 discipline) — the pairing is a documented 2-line shell recipe; SUCCESSOR vars already validate the count handoff; a --plan file buys nothing over grep.
• PD-PARITY GAP (real, undocumented): the scaffold plants a generic text-only @inputs entry; the moment the real renderer grows richer attrs, the frozen golden goes STALE and the freshness test reds until someone hand-edits @inputs and re-runs gen_pd_parity + completeness.sh + the golden test. Neither command's prose says so. This second regen is a mandatory grow step for BOTH new blocks.
• EDITOR TRUTH (changes scope): Studio editability is NOT scaffolded and NOT automatic. Two per-type registries exist — classic paper_block_fields/1 (paper_editor.ex:1041-1376, catch-all = read-only) and canvas ProseMirror nodes (bpOpaque verbatim-carry fallback). Every block added since code/diagram (heatmap, chart, chat-*, task-board) is VIEW-ONLY in Studio today. Full editability costs ~350-500 lines/block by the diagram precedent (439-line canvas node + ~29-line classic clause). Decide MUST rule the tier: attr-atom editable vs View-only-for-now.
• BENCHMARK HONESTY: no measured pre-scaffy baseline for add-block-type exists or is coming — W6's D65 matrix scopes the flagship to A-vs-C only, and D69a BANS the 56-80k folklore as data. W6 has produced ZERO committed results yet (round 1 in flight; no tooling/scaffy-duels on main). The honest table: scaffold duration_ms + tokens=0 (first-party), grow-time per surface via the D66 claude -p JSON meter (recipe is charter prose, not a W6 library — zero collision), and 'no measured pre-scaffy baseline' stated plainly. Cold-worktree pnpm install (~4min+) is a shared per-worktree cost that must be isolated or it swamps per-block numbers.
• W5 RECONCILE LANDED: PR #3923 merged (c70dfeb60); corpus_test.go=14 on origin/main matching 14 command files; 14 commands live on guerrilla (curl-confirmed). The no-touch-zone is LIFTED. W7 authors no new .scaffy file, so corpus_test.go stays untouched (D61 upheld by omission).
• PAPER MECHANICS: portabledoc + scaffy tags registered; diff, filetree, benchmark ALL unregistered — W7 must pre-register diff/filetree type:tag docs before publish or 422 unknown_tag (do not assume W6's prereg covers them). Showcase payload convention: scaffy/showcase/*.json, slug/style/description/tags[]/blocks[]. Wave paper and showcase paper are two artifacts, two slugs.
• EXTRAS: clean CUT confirmed — zero evidence for pr-card, commit-card, or annotated-code-with-line-highlights anywhere (repo grep + quoted-phrase paper search + github plugin has no PortableDoc path at all). filetree + diff have verbatim hand-faked precedent (● created / ○ injected typed as ASCII art in live papers; 'diff' 104x in the showcase paper).
• FILETREE IDIOM: core vocabulary is stable (● created / ○ injected / ✕ removed) but the corpus carries TWO annotation sub-styles (column-aligned status word vs #-comment role text) and NO formal legend has ever existed — shipping a legend affordance is a NEW convention, to be stated honestly. Glyph polarity clash flagged: task-status vocabulary uses ●=done/○=open (inline.go:226-241) — opposite pairing, different domain; needs a stated-reasons note, not silent reuse.
• TUI ASSETS: chroma already ships a diff lexer (lang=diff colors code blocks today) but that is NOT honest +/- semantics; the reusable idiom is chat_blocks.go's prefix+style+budget family. MinWidth=20 drop-chrome-first and truncate-don't-rewrap are the established degrade laws.

Contradictions and decisions-in-waiting

• TIER CONTRADICTION: block-classification scout argues diff/filetree are :widget (chat-tool-diff precedent, tiers.ex:82); chain-need-census's recipe used Tier=element. The widget case is better-evidenced (self-contained rendered display units). Verify runs the chain with Tier=widget; Decide rules finally.
• DELEGATE-VS-DIFFERENTIATE SPLIT (Elixir surface): diff-prior-art says differentiate + shared row helper (chat_tool_diff_html requires tool-input shape); surface-map-elixir leans delegate to chat_tool_diff_html with a thin wrapper. These conflict at the build layer. The verify fleet probes factorability; Decide rules with stated reasons — the charter law is 'never two independent diff renderers' at the RENDERING layer.
• EDITOR TIER AMBIGUITY: 'view-edit parity' as a deliverable is unpriced until Decide picks editable-attr-atom vs View-only. If View-only, parity reduces to render-identical in View and read-only Studio preview; if editable, add ~2 more surfaces of grow work per block that the benchmark must meter separately.
• CHARTER SELF-TENSION: D65 justifies skipping add-block-type's arm-B using the very 56-80k figure D69a bans — the W7 paper must not smuggle the banned number back in through this door.
• OPERATIONAL PRECONDITION: THIS checkout is stale (behind origin/main; missing classify-block-type.scaffy; TestCorpusFileCount reds locally at 12-vs-7) and carries 4 unpushed local docs commits. Every W7 worktree must cut from origin/main, and the checkout wants a pull/rebase before Build.
• HUNK HEADERS: does the diff block parse/render @@ hunk headers and ---/+++ file headers, and is multi-file diff in or out? chat-tool-diff has no hunk concept; the wish implies single-file ('file/lang metadata', singular). Decide call.

Coverage map — checked+found vs checked+ABSENT
